title: A content editor that ends where your repository begins.
summary: Mica is for content-driven business sites with a small editing team and a few hundred entries. It gives editors the right controls and gives developers a file system they can trust.

audiences.title: For editors
audiences.text: Use clear forms, useful field labels, rich text, media, relations, and reorderable lists. Save freely: a save is a draft until somebody publishes it, and all editors of the site see it. The Publish page shows what each pending change does, field by field. You choose which changes to publish, and they become one commit.

audiences.title: For developers
audiences.text: Define the model in TypeScript and use getCollection in Astro. Content is local, typed, diffable, and available without a live CMS or a read token.

audiences.title: For operators
audiences.text: Run one container with OpenID Connect. It keeps a Git clone of your repository on one volume. There is no database, cache, queue, object store, content API, or build webhook.
